integrity: Self-contained proof and standalone exact rational checker; checker verified 9369 finite identities and finite-event distribution comparisons. Finite checks do not establish asymptotic convergence.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive Poisson birth and jump rates, one walker, complete graphs only; no Berry-Esseen or functional discovery-process theorem. The early-preprint source and one relevant 2020 full text were unavailable for comprehensive novelty assessment.
title: Joint Gaussian arrivals and discoveries in Poisson-grown complete graphs
